---
title: "Week 13 Coding Challenge"
---

Load the example project at [https://github.com/jdfoote/Intro-to-Programming-and-Data-Science/raw/refs/heads/master/day_13/example_project.zip](https://github.com/jdfoote/Intro-to-Programming-and-Data-Science/raw/refs/heads/master/day_13/example_project.zip)

Tweak it to answer your own question using Reddit data. See if you can create your own visualization.

You probably won't be able to get the LaTeX portion to work because it requires installing LaTeX on your computer, which I actually don't recommend - I recommend using Overleaf instead.

## Submission

Submit your completed work via Brightspace.

## Presentation

Be prepared to present your solution if randomly selected during class.
